description.text: The other second expansion of the Sun & Moon series, released together with Islands Await You on 17 March 2017, with more new Pokémon of the Alola region. Tapu Koko and Lycanroc in its Midnight Form appear on the two wrappers. Alolan Moonlight holds Lycanroc-GX, Tapu Lele-GX, Wishiwashi-GX and Metagross-GX. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 50, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX and Mallow, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Aqua Patch, Enhanced Hammer and Fighting Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Guardians Rising in May 2017.
